text:
frank: Following the PM writeup, we need final owners and tickets for three items: (1) short-term eviction hysteresis fix, (2) regression/eval coverage, (3) consolidate recurring-incident notes. Who can pick these up?
gina: I can own (1) eviction hysteresis and open a Jira. Will include a small perf test to show improvement.
hannah: I'll take (2) regression/eval coverage and add a nightly CI check.
ian: I'll consolidate the incident timeline and attach the grep outputs and short RCA. (typo: i'm Ian)
pm-bot: Jira RW-5333 created by @gina - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-5333
gina: RW-5333: decrease eviction threshold hysteresis + add backpressure hook. Assignee=gina. Target PR: 2026-04-08. AC: under synthetic "prefix-stress" the kv_cache_size 95th pct does not increase >10% over baseline for 24h.
hannah: For evals I'll add a nightly job that runs the "long-context-burst" generator and records kv and eviction counts. AC: CI fails if 95th pct memory >8% for 3 consecutive runs.
ian: I'll attach grep commands and two sample incident snippets to RW-5333 under Diagnostics. Grep I'll use:
```
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/* | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 40
awk '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $0}' /var/log/incidents.log | sed -n '1,150p'
```
gina: Proposed RACI (I'll paste into the ticket): Gina=R, Hannah=A, Ian=C, Frank=I. Anyone object?
hannah: fine with that. I'll coordinate the CI acceptance criteria with Gina so the canary has matching alerts.
pm-bot: Reminder created: PM follow-up RW-5333 sync - 2026-04-07 09:30 UTC
canary-bot: Canary scheduled for rw-dedicated-prod by @gina on 2026-04-10T02:00Z
frank: Timeline plan: PR by 2026-04-08, internal review 2026-04-09, staged canary 2026-04-10-11, close PM follow-up by 2026-04-17 if canary stable. If canary flags regressions we rollback and open RW-5334 for investigation.
gina: I'll add the rollback steps and monitoring dashboard links to RW-5333.
hannah: I'll post the CI job YAML to the ticket and wire up alerting for 95th pct kv growth.
ian: I'll finalize the incident correlation doc and include a one-line recurrence estimate (low/medium/high) and link the two prior incident IDs.
frank: Thanks all. Keep updates in RW-5333; we'll only post final closure here once ACs met.
gina: ack :thumbsup:
hannah: ack
